narr: An outflow boundary moved inland from the coast and generated thunderstorms over the Coastal Plains. Some of these storms produced locally heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. There was water over Hwy 119 along with other low water crossings flooded near Smith Creek south of Yorktown.
lsr: Flooded low water crossings and water over SH 119 south of Yorktown.
